Major technology companies like Meta, Alphabet, and Microsoft are increasing their capital outlays to strengthen AI infrastructure. The Nasdaq 100 index has already seen a significant decline of more than 5.8% in October. Analysts predict that global AI infrastructure spending could reach unprecedented levels by 2030.

title: Reddit stock plunges 30% as Google's AI search threatens traffic and user growth

Pinterest also fell after issuing a weaker revenue outlook, as pressure on European cross border sellers weighed on its business and growth expectations.

title: Intel stock plunges 30% as weak PC demand and AI costs trigger global chip selloff

The warning triggered a global semiconductor selloff, with Nvidia, AMD and other chip stocks declining as weak PC demand and rising AI infrastructure costs weighed on sentiment.

title: Sun Pharma Q2 profit falls 36% as litigation costs hit earnings

title: Syrma SGS reports best-ever quarter; Q2 revenue up 73% to Rs 1,999.5 crore

Consolidated revenue increased by 73.2%, reaching a record high of Rs 1,999.5 crore. The company’s exports grew by 91% year-on-year, showcasing strong international demand. Investments are planned in collaboration with Kaga Electronics to enhance the domestic supply ecosystem.

Operating revenue increased by 13%, largely due to growth in subscription revenue supported by the FIFA World Cup 2026. Total expenditure rose by 18% primarily driven by increased programming and promotional costs. ZEE5, the company's streaming platform, showed significant growth by doubling its revenue year-on-year.
